title: Check inherited native-operation guards before adding wrapper validation
applies_when: A partial wrapper, long definition or dispatch macro lacks a visible validation and a candidate alleges silent invalid-input behavior; especially tensor views or Python/C++ native boundaries.
lesson: Follow the exact caller and native binding before buying an expensive reproduction or adding duplicate validation. In vLLM QuickReduce, the macro has no fallback but its allreduce caller rejects unsupported world sizes before dispatch. TransformerEngine ep_bootstrap computes local experts by floor division only after the native initializer validates divisibility. Preserve the whole call chain and guard ordering, not only a matching check string. A long function's docstring can precede a guard outside the supplied window: MegaMoE explicitly rejects unpaired shared_x_sf/shared_block_m before its Triton launch. Read the missing body and inspect the actual delivered packet after prompt-budget trimming; retrieving a tail does not guarantee the model receives it. For Torch as_strided, the concrete TensorImpl path calls setStrided and checks size/stride/storage_offset against storage capacity. Contrast exact-fit and undersized inputs through the actual pinned wrapper using real Torch; a permissive stand-in removes the inherited guard. A custom kernel can still escape a logical tensor while staying inside its backing allocation. To test this safely, cover every padded lane with accessible task-owned guard cells, keep logical inputs finite, and vary only the outside tail between finite and NaN controls. vLLM recurrent KDA K=100 exposed float32/BF16 output contamination; the key mask repaired it, while finite-tail and K=128 controls passed. Compare the real reviewed kernel/wrapper with an independent oracle, not a copied arithmetic model. Static caller evidence can refute a particular silent-failure premise without qualifying GPU behavior or proving every entrypoint safe.
avoid_when: A guard after the side effect, a bypassing entrypoint, mismatched group identities, compile-time-disabled validation or a native error swallowed by the caller requires separate investigation. A clearer public error contract may still justify wrapper validation. Storage capacity is not the wrapper's logical subregion or ownership boundary: larger backing storage can admit an escaping view. Overlap, wrong offsets, unchecked custom kernels and meta/symbolic paths need separate evidence. An accessible poisoned tail is not an out-of-allocation sanitizer reproducer; verify vector spans and offsets, and never poison legitimate input values. NaN propagation is kernel-specific, so a clean witness does not prove absence of reads. Do not generalize source-only counterexamples or derived kernel checks to full-package imports, other copies/backends, models, performance, all callers or measured Scout conversion benefit.

evidence.note: The host function checks paired shared_x_sf/shared_block_m, UE8M0 mode, positive block size and scale-buffer shape/capacity before the kernel launch. A window ending480 misses these guards. Empty batches return earlier. This source refutes a missing-pair-check premise, not all dtype/device/kernel behavior or a measured Scout benefit.

Kernel computes padded key lanes and mask_k, but the KDA gate load was unmasked. Independent safe derived kernel/wrapper screening on RTX5090: baseline two failed/two controls passed, masked version four passed against a recurrence oracle. Not full vLLM, all copied kernels or sanitizer qualification.

Existing author's PR61814 uses NaNs after a logical gate view inside larger allocated g_storage. This supports a logical-boundary witness, not the test comment's allocation-level sanitizer claim. The author already owns the repair, including two additional GLM5Next copies; do not open a competing PR.

checkInBoundsForStorage computes required bytes including storage offset and rejects a request exceeding backing storage. This is a version-specific native mechanism, not an application-wide safety proof.
The concrete as_strided_tensorimpl path invokes setStrided; Resize.h lines 184-203 in turn invoke the storage-capacity check. Meta and unchecked helper paths must not inherit this conclusion blindly.

Mamba conv and temporal views are created through real torch.as_strided. Absence of a wrapper assertion alone does not bypass the native check; logical subregions and valid caller invariants remain separate questions.

The allreduce member rejects world sizes outside 2/4/8 before its TWOSHOT_DISPATCH uses. An initial lines 1-120 excerpt omitted this guard; macro absence alone did not establish silent no-op. Exact-source review, not HIP execution.

validate_config rejects num_experts % ep_size != 0; initialize calls it before inst.init. The inspected ep_bootstrap -> PyTorch extension ep_initialize -> nvte_ep_initialize -> EPBackend::initialize chain precedes Python's local-expert floor division. This refutes that chain's silent-truncation premise, not runtime/CUDA/NCCL correctness.
